title: Conormal comparison for restricted universal thickening
statement: For the open restriction data of a universal first order thickening, the restricted map is formally unramified and its conormal sheaf is canonically isomorphic to the restriction of the original conormal sheaf.

source.place: Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA and Definition 01R2

proof.text: Use the restricted square-zero ideal from the open restriction of the thickening. Formal unramifiedness of the restricted map follows from the open restriction property, and the conormal modules are the pullbacks of the ideals. Pullback composition and the open-immersion restriction comparison identify the restricted original conormal with the restricted conormal; the existence theorem supplies the required witness and universal thickening data.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_open_restriction_conormal
    {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X)
    (H : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h')
    (hform : FormallyUnramified h)
    {V : Z.Opens} {U : X.Opens}
    {hV : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme} {V' : Z'.Opens}
    {iV : V.toScheme ⟶ V'.toScheme} {hV' : V'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme}
    (hdata : i ⁻¹ᵁ V' = V ∧ V' ≤ h' ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
      iV ≫ V'.ι = V.ι ≫ i ∧ hV' ≫ U.ι = V'.ι ≫ h' ∧
      iV ≫ hV' = hV ∧ IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV') :
    ∃ (hVform : FormallyUnramified hV),
      ∃ (HV : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV'),
        Nonempty
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
              (@formallyUnramifiedConormal _ _ _ h hform i h' H) ≅
            @formallyUnramifiedConormal _ _ _ hV hVform iV hV' HV)
